limitations: Budgets are arbitrary; a better SAT encoding or symmetry breaking may scale further.
statement: With fixed budgets, lexicographic DFS (3e6 nodes) and a SAT encoding (3e5 conflicts) find full-period quasigroups only up to n = 8, while seeded sampling of random Latin squares finds them for every n = 5..16 at rates close to 1/n^2 (H-C16-11).
title: Random sampling finds full-period quasigroups where exact search fails
